'''Parsons''', better known by his stage name, '''the Anvil''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] native to the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Biography==
A resident of the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Worlport/Legends|Worlport]], Parsons was an undercut thug with delusions of grandeur. Donning a red mask and taking the stage name "the Anvil", he became a midrate fighter in the arenas of the [[Loaded Savrip]]. While his career was not a promising one, due to a string of bad luck, he had become a fixture at the Savrip during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="MPQ" />
